target: Final-stage strongest Republican versus strongest non-Republican candidate margin, divided by their combined votes; independent opponents included
features: six-year prior same-seat final margin adjusted for strictly prior national presidential margin
signed prior winner on first-round general entrant list
selection: Expanding-cycle MSE through 2018; normalize only training rows. No selection on already observed 2020/2022/2024 diagnostics.
finalStagePolicy: Use primary-source final-stage overrides where identified; otherwise certified GEN RUNOFF/runoff before gen. Odd-year Georgia regular runoff maps to preceding election cycle. Reject unresolved majority-runoff, RCV, duplicate ballot-line/mode and ambiguous party labels.
incumbencyPolicy: Use first-round general entrants, never the outcome-selected finalist list. Overrides of outcomes do not alter entrant features.
limitations: Final revised election returns and candidate identities are not original forecast vintages.
Candidate identity aliases, appointments and replacements can impair incumbency inference.
This margin model includes independent opponents but does not certify 2026 probability calibration or market profitability.
Complex elections without a verified final comparable margin are excluded explicitly.
An updated model fit does not renew expired polling, qualify a production forecast or reset any live budget or accounting.
